rules.safety_requirement: must ensure length >= 2 before writing buffer[length-2]
rules.note: Null terminator write at index length-2 requires length >= 2.

rules.safety_requirement: must check that AcquireString(buffer) returns non-NULL before using value
rules.note: Allocation result assigned to value without a linked null check.

rules.safety_requirement: must ensure exif points to at least one readable byte before ReadPropertyByte dereferences it
rules.applicable_condition: when the EXIF signature scan loop is entered
rules.note: ReadPropertyByte advances exif and decrements length; loop condition length != 0 and prior length >= 6 guard are linked.

rules.safety_requirement: must ensure exif+4 through exif+7 are within the EXIF buffer before ReadPropertySignedLong reads them
rules.applicable_condition: when reading the signed long offset from exif+4
rules.note: Reads four bytes at exif+4; linked facts only establish exif+2 signature check, not that exif+4..exif+7 are in bounds.

rules.safety_requirement: must ensure directory points to at least two readable bytes before ReadPropertyUnsignedShort reads directory
rules.applicable_condition: when the IFD entry-count read is reached
rules.note: Directory bound check allows directory <= exif+length-2, which may leave fewer than two bytes for the unsigned short read.

rules.safety_requirement: must ensure directory+12*entry+2 does not exceed the EXIF buffer before dereferencing q
rules.applicable_condition: when computing q for an IFD entry
rules.note: q is computed before the q > exif+length-12 break check; the check occurs after pointer arithmetic.

rules.safety_requirement: must ensure components * tag_bytes[format] does not overflow size_t before number_bytes is used for allocation or copying
rules.applicable_condition: when components and tag_bytes[format] are multiplied
rules.note: components is checked non-negative and format is bounded, but the multiplication itself is not checked for overflow.

rules.safety_requirement: must check that AcquireQuantumMemory returns non-NULL before using value
rules.applicable_condition: when allocating number_bytes+1 bytes for value
rules.note: Allocation result is assigned to value; linked state shows a later non-NULL branch but not a failure-path check.
